reviewer: AI assistant visual_perception agent, separate from module author
method: Read prose and implementation, manually checked fixture cost arguments, and reproduced the six exact optimum comparisons. This is a documentation consistency review, not an independent proof kernel.
wording_notes: At zero-cost terminal states the implementation intentionally prunes positive-cost query alternatives using the nonnegative lower bound; qualify wording that all query subproblems are always enumerated.

Noisy-resolvable action cost2 is achieved by querying side_camera directly; taking the frontal camera first can raise worst-case sensing cost to3. Calling it an alternative side view avoids implying a mandatory two-query sequence.

The support-table model permits all cross-experiment combinations consistent with a fixed world; it does not encode joint cross-sensor correlations. This is a scope clarification, not a stochastic independence requirement.
